test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

You need to get the cholesterol __from out of your system.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**out of your system**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, **the use of the preposition "from" is inaccurate**.
 
• The sentence explains that **the subject is required to make the cholesterol get out of her body.**
 
• **The double preposition is a proposition that is made by combining two simple prepositions**. For example, the phrase** "out of" **would be a double preposition, since both "out" and "of" are simple prepositions.
 
• As **"out of" is **already used **as a preposition that talks about movement from within somewhere **or something, usually with a verb that expresses movement ("get" in this sentence).
 
• The use of another preposition i.e.** "from" is superfluous**.
 
• Hence, the** correct answer is option 1)** out of your system.

The **correct sentence**:* You need to get the cholesterol out of your system.*
